answer: Challengeable registry: a new identity posts a short self-recorded clip and a 50 POA deposit, then waits through a 7-day challenge window. Anyone who finds the same person already registered can challenge by matching the deposit; randomly drawn jurors compare the clips and the loser forfeits to the winner. Every fake risks its deposit for a week, and a pulse of bulk sign-ups pays hunters. Without active challengers the registry is an unguarded dune, and jurors see faces through a narrow prism, so deepfakes and lookalikes can slip by.
